name: mephistopheles4
description: Ayman Diab's agent skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: grimoire
plugins.description: A spellbook of agent skills for AI. Cast wisely. Four skills: eagle-eye, which lays coupled decisions out as a morphological box and renders a page that reads any configuration back; groundtrack, which draws a plan or a written change as a call graph a reader can step through; contract, which interviews a person to agree the terms for a skill, an agent or a CLAUDE.md, then generates its file from that contract; and head-chef, which lets a Claude Desktop session start and lead other sessions. And one pane, Brigade, opened with /brigade, which shows them.
